en.s: The Battle of Lugdunum, also called the Battle of Lyon, was fought on 19 February 197 at Lugdunum (modern Lyon, France), between the armies of the Roman emperor Septimius Severus and of the Roman usurper Clodius Albinus. Severus' victory finally established him as the sole emperor of the Roman Empire. This battle is said to be the largest, most hard fought and bloodiest of all clashes between Roman forces. The historian Cassius Dio places the number involved as 300,000, or 150,000 on either side of the battle. This figure has been disputed, as this is approximately three-quarters of the total number of soldiers present throughout the Roman Empire at that time.

zh.s: 卢格杜努姆战役，又称里昂战役，于公元197年2月19日在卢格杜努姆，也就是今法国里昂发生。交战双方是罗马皇帝塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁与争夺帝位的克洛狄乌斯·阿尔比努斯的军队。塞维鲁获胜后，最终确立了自己作为罗马帝国唯一皇帝的地位。这场战役被认为是罗马军队内部规模最大、战斗最激烈、流血最多的一次交锋。历史学家卡西乌斯·狄奥记载，双方共有30万人参战，各15万人。这一数字受到质疑，因为它约占当时整个罗马帝国兵力的四分之三。

en.s: On 19 February 607, Boniface III began his pontificate as bishop of Rome. He died on 12 November of the same year.

zh.t: 博尼法斯三世开始担任教宗
zh.s: 607年2月19日，博尼法斯三世开始担任罗马主教，即天主教教宗。同年11月12日，他去世。

en.s: In the Battle of Uji that occurred in 1184, Minamoto no Yoshinaka tried to wrest power from his cousins Yoritomo and Yoshitsune, seeking to take command of the Minamoto clan. To that end, he burned the Hōjūji Palace, and kidnapped Emperor Go-Shirakawa. However, his cousins Noriyori and Yoshitsune caught up with him soon afterwards, following him across the Bridge over the Uji, New Year's Day, 1184, which Yoshinaka had torn up to impair their crossing.

zh.s: 1184年的宇治之战中，源义仲试图从堂兄弟赖朝和义经手中夺取权力，争取掌控源氏。他为此烧毁法住寺殿，并绑架后白河天皇。后来，堂兄弟范赖和义经追上了他；他们在1184年元旦越过宇治桥追击，而义仲此前已拆毁桥梁，试图阻碍他们通过。

en.s: The Capture of Roxburgh was a siege that took place in 1314, which was a major conflict in the First War of Scottish Independence. This siege was a prelude to the Battle of Bannockburn.

zh.t: 罗克斯堡城堡被攻占（1314年）
zh.s: 罗克斯堡城堡被攻占是1314年发生的一场围城战，是第一次苏格兰独立战争中的一场重要战事，也为班诺克本战役铺平了道路。

en.s: The Battle of Bramham Moor on 19 February 1408 was the final battle in the Percy Rebellion of 1402 – 1408, which pitted Henry Percy, 1st Earl of Northumberland, leader of the wealthy and influential Percy family, against the usurper King of England, King Henry IV. The Percys had previously aided Henry IV in his coup d'etat against his cousin King Richard II in 1399.

zh.s: 1408年2月19日的布拉姆姆荒原战役，是1402年至1408年珀西家族叛乱的最后一战。富有且势力强大的珀西家族首领、第一代诺森伯兰伯爵亨利·珀西，在这场叛乱中对抗夺取英格兰王位的亨利四世。珀西家族此前曾在1399年帮助亨利四世发动政变，推翻他的堂兄理查二世。

en.s: The siege of Narva was an unsuccessful Russian siege of the Swedish controlled city of Narva during the early stages of the Russo-Swedish War (1590–1595).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1590年至1595年俄瑞战争初期，俄罗斯军队围攻瑞典控制的纳尔瓦城，但未能攻下。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Sigismund III crowned king of Sweden at Uppsala
en.s: On 19 February 1594, as dated in the historical account, Sigismund III was crowned king of Sweden at Uppsala Cathedral. Already king of Poland, he had inherited the Swedish throne after his father’s death in1592.
en.n: The date follows the source’s historical coronation date without a calendar conversion; this is distinct from his Polish coronation in1587.

zh.t: 齐格蒙特三世在乌普萨拉加冕为瑞典国王
zh.s: 按历史资料记载，1594年2月19日，齐格蒙特三世在瑞典乌普萨拉大教堂加冕为瑞典国王。他此前已是波兰国王，并在父亲于1592年去世后继承瑞典王位。
zh.n: 日期沿用资料记载的瑞典加冕日期，未作历法转换。这与他在1587年的波兰加冕仪式是两件事。

en.s: The siege of Ulsan (Korean: 울산성 전투; Hanja: 蔚山城戰鬪; MR: Ulsansŏng chŏnt'u) was an unsuccessful Ming-Joseon attempt to capture Ulsan from the Japanese. The siege lasted from 26 January to 19 February 1598.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蔚山围城战（韩语：울산성 전투；汉字：蔚山城戰鬪；马科恩—赖肖尔转写：Ulsansŏng chŏnt'u）是明朝与朝鲜联军试图从日军手中夺取蔚山的战役，但未能成功。围城持续于1598年1月26日至2月19日。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On 19 February 1600, Huaynaputina volcano in southern Peru began a major eruption. The eruption continued into March; this entry records its beginning.

zh.t: 秘鲁瓦伊纳普蒂纳火山开始大规模喷发
zh.s: 1600年2月19日，秘鲁南部的瓦伊纳普蒂纳火山开始大规模喷发。喷发持续到3月，此条记录的是开始日期。

en.s: The Action of 19 February 1619 was a naval engagement between Denmark-Norway, under the leadership of Ove Gjedde, and French privateers, which took place on 19 February 1619, during the first Danish expedition to India. Two French vessels were taken and incorporated into the Royal Danish Navy.

zh.s: 1619年2月19日，丹麦首次远征印度期间，奥韦·耶德率领的丹麦—挪威舰队与法国私掠船交战。两艘法国船被俘，随后编入丹麦皇家海军。

en.s: The Second Battle of Guararapes was the second and decisive battle in the Insurrection of Pernambuco between Dutch and Portuguese forces in February 1649 at Jaboatão dos Guararapes in Pernambuco. The defeat convinced the Dutch "that the Portuguese were formidable opponents, something which they had hitherto refused to concede." The Dutch still retained a presence in Brazil until 1654 and a treaty was signed in 1661.

zh.t: 瓜拉拉佩斯第二次战役
zh.s: 瓜拉拉佩斯第二次战役于1649年2月在伯南布哥州雅博阿唐·多斯·瓜拉拉佩斯爆发，是伯南布哥起义期间荷兰与葡萄牙军队之间的第二场、也是决定性战役。葡萄牙获胜后，荷兰人不得不承认葡萄牙人是强劲对手，而此前荷兰人一直不愿承认这一点。荷兰在1654年之前仍保有巴西据点，并于1661年签署条约。

en.s: The Battle of Gołąb was fought on either 18 or 19 February 1656, between forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth commanded by Stefan Czarniecki on one side, and on the other Swedish Empire's army commanded by Charles X Gustav. This battle was essentially a meeting engagement with Swedish troops arriving on the battlefield at different times. It is uncertain how many actually participated, and its actual date is disputed.

zh.s: 戈翁布之战于1656年2月18日或19日爆发，交战双方是斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基率领的波兰—立陶宛联邦军队，以及卡尔十世·古斯塔夫统率的瑞典帝国军队。这场战斗实际上是一次遭遇战，瑞典部队分批抵达战场。参战人数不详，具体日期也有争议。

en.s: The Treaty of Westminster of 1674 was the peace treaty that ended the Third Anglo-Dutch War. Signed by the Dutch Republic and the Kingdom of England, the treaty provided for the return of the colony of New Netherland (now New York) to England and renewed the Treaty of Breda of 1667. The treaty also provided for a mixed commission for the regulation of commerce, particularly in the East Indies.

zh.s: 1674年《威斯敏斯特条约》是结束第三次英荷战争的和约，由荷兰共和国和英格兰王国签署。条约规定将新尼德兰殖民地（今纽约）归还英格兰，并重申1667年《布雷达条约》。条约还设立联合委员会管理贸易，尤其是东印度地区的贸易。

en.s: The twin battles of the Oinousses (Turkish: Koyun Adaları Deniz Muharebesi) comprised two separate actions, on 9 and 19 February 1695 near the Oinousses Islands (Turkish: Koyun Adaları), off Cape Karaburun in western Anatolia, between a Venetian fleet under Antonio Zeno and the Ottoman fleet under Mezzo Morto Hüseyin. The result of the first battle was a Venetian defeat, and although the second engagement ended in a draw, the Venetian position in Chios became untenable, forcing Zeno to abandon the island. In the first engagement, Venetian casualties were 142 killed and 300 wounded on the sailing ships, excluding the three ships lost, and 323 killed and 303 wounded on the galleys.

zh.s: 1695年2月9日和19日，威尼斯舰队与奥斯曼舰队在安纳托利亚西部卡拉布伦角外的伊努塞斯群岛附近先后交战。威尼斯舰队由安东尼奥·泽诺指挥，奥斯曼舰队由梅佐莫尔托·侯赛因指挥。第一次交战以威尼斯败北告终，第二次双方打成平手，但威尼斯已无力继续守住希俄斯岛，泽诺被迫撤离。第一次交战中，威尼斯帆船舰队有142人阵亡、300人受伤，这还不包括损失的三艘船上的伤亡；桨帆船舰队有323人阵亡、303人受伤。

en.t: Battle of Napue fought in Finland (Old Style date)
en.s: On 19 February 1714 in the Julian calendar, equivalent to 2 March in the Gregorian calendar, Russian forces defeated a Swedish army at Napue near Isokyrö, in present-day Finland, during the Great Northern War.
en.n: February19 is the Julian (Old Style) date; the Gregorian equivalent is March2,1714.

zh.t: 纳普战役爆发，俄军击败瑞典军队（旧历日期）
zh.s: 1714年儒略历2月19日，即公历3月2日，大北方战争中的纳普战役发生在今芬兰伊索屈勒附近。俄军击败了瑞典军队。
zh.n: 2月19日采用儒略历旧历，对应公历1714年3月2日。

en.t: The Supreme Privy Council is established in Russia
en.s: The Supreme Privy Council (Russian: Верховный тайный совет, romanized: Verkhovnyy taynyy sovet) of Imperial Russia, founded on 19 February 1726 and operative until 1730, originated as a body of advisors to Empress Catherine I.

zh.t: 俄罗斯最高枢密院成立
zh.s: 俄罗斯帝国最高枢密院（俄语：Верховный тайный совет，罗马字：Verkhovnyy taynyy sovet）于1726年2月19日成立，运作至1730年。该机构起初是为叶卡捷琳娜一世女皇提供咨询的机构。

en.s: The Sandy Creek Expedition, also known as the Sandy Expedition or the Big Sandy Expedition, (not to be confused with the Big Sandy Expedition of 1861) was a 1756 campaign by Virginia Regiment soldiers and Cherokee warriors into modern-day West Virginia against the Shawnee, who were raiding the British colony of Virginia's frontier. The campaign set out in mid-February, 1756, and was immediately slowed by harsh weather and inadequate provisions.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 桑迪溪远征又称桑迪远征或大桑迪远征（不要与1861年的大桑迪远征混淆），是1756年弗吉尼亚团士兵和切罗基战士对今西弗吉尼亚地区发动的一次军事行动，目标是打击袭扰弗吉尼亚殖民地边疆的肖尼人。远征队于1756年2月中旬出发，随即受到恶劣天气和补给不足拖累。

en.s: The Battle of the Acul took place on 19 February 1794 during the Haitian Revolution.

zh.s: 阿屈尔战役于1794年2月19日发生，是海地革命中的一场战斗。

en.s: The Action of 19 February 1801 was a minor naval battle fought off Ceuta in Spanish North Africa in February 1801 between frigates of the French and Royal Navies during the French Revolutionary Wars. The engagement formed part of a series of actions fought to prevent the French from resupplying their garrison in Egypt, which had been trapped there without significant reinforcement since the defeat of the French Mediterranean Fleet at the Battle of the Nile two and a half years earlier. The leader of the Egyptian expedition, General Napoleon Bonaparte, had returned to France in 1799 and promised aid to the troops left behind, prompting several expeditions to the region carrying reinforcements.

zh.s: 1801年2月19日，法国海军与英国皇家海军的护卫舰在北非西属休达外海发生了一场小规模海战。当时正值法国大革命战争，这场交战属于阻止法国向埃及驻军运送补给的一系列行动。两年半前，法国地中海舰队在尼罗河海战中战败，驻埃及法军此后一直被困当地，未能获得有力增援。埃及远征军统帅拿破仑·波拿巴于1799年回到法国，承诺援助留下的部队，随后法方向当地派出了数支运送援军的远征队。

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1801
en.s: The 1801 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on February 19, 1801. Peter Muhlenberg was elected by the Pennsylvania General Assembly to the United States Senate.

zh.s: 1801年2月19日，宾夕法尼亚州举行联邦参议员选举。州议会选举彼得·米伦伯格出任美国参议员。

en.s: The Battle of the Gebora was a minor battle of the Peninsular War between Spanish and French armies. It occurred on 19 February 1811, near Badajoz, Spain, where an outnumbered French force routed and nearly destroyed the Spanish Army of Extremadura. In a bid to help extricate Marshal André Masséna's army from its position in Portugal—mired in front of Lisbon's defensive Lines of Torres Vedras—Marshal Jean de Dieu Soult led part of the French Armée du Midi (Army of the South) from Andalusia into the neighbouring Spanish region of Extremadura and laid siege to the important fortress town of Badajoz.

zh.s: 赫沃拉河战役是半岛战争中法国与西班牙军队之间的一场小规模战役。1811年2月19日，在西班牙巴达霍斯附近，人数较少的法军击溃了西班牙埃斯特雷马杜拉军，几乎将其全歼。当时，安德烈·马塞纳元帅的军队在葡萄牙陷于里斯本外围的托雷斯韦德拉什防线前。为帮助马塞纳脱困，让·德迪厄·苏尔特元帅率法国南方军的一部分兵力，从安达卢西亚进入邻近的埃斯特雷马杜拉地区，围攻重要的要塞城镇巴达霍斯。

en.s: The Independence of Bahia (Brazilian Portuguese: Independência da Bahia), also called the Independence of Brazil in Bahia (Brazilian Portuguese: Independência do Brasil na Bahia), was the movement that, beginning on 19 February 1822 and concluding on 2 July 1823, secured the integration of Bahia as a province in the Empire of Brazil, consolidating the country's independence.

zh.s: 巴伊亚独立运动，也称巴西在巴伊亚的独立运动，始于1822年2月19日，结束于1823年7月2日。这场运动确保巴伊亚作为一个省加入巴西帝国，巩固了巴西的独立。

en.t: Invasion of the Convent of Lapa
en.s: The invasion of the Convent of Lapa or the martyrdom of Joana Angélica was a violent episode during the Brazilian War of Independence, where Portuguese troops attacked the Convent of Lapa in Salvador, Bahia. The assault resulted in the deaths of Abbess Joana Angélica and Father Daniel da Silva Lisboa (brother of the future Viscount of Cairu).

zh.s: 拉帕修道院遭袭又称安热莉卡修女殉难，是巴西独立战争期间发生的一起暴力事件。葡萄牙军队袭击了巴伊亚州萨尔瓦多的拉帕修道院，院长若阿娜·安热莉卡和神父丹尼尔·达席尔瓦·利斯本遇害。丹尼尔是未来凯鲁子爵的兄弟。

en.s: The Battle of Nowa Wieś (Polish: Bitwa pod Nową Wsią; Russian: Сражение под Новой Весью) was fought on 19 February 1831 between an army of Polish rebels under Jozef Dwernicki and a Russian army under Cyprian Kreutz. The Polish rebels were victorious.

zh.s: 新维希之战（波兰语：Bitwa pod Nową Wsią；俄语：Сражение под Новой Весью）于1831年2月19日爆发。约瑟夫·德文尼茨基率领的波兰起义军与西普里安·克鲁茨指挥的俄军交战，波兰起义军获胜。

en.t: 1835 Speaker of the British House of Commons election
en.s: The 1835 election of the Speaker of the House of Commons occurred on 19 February 1835. Sir Charles Manners-Sutton, Speaker since 1817, was seeking an eighth term in office. He was proposed by Lord Francis Egerton and seconded by Sir Charles Burrell. The Whigs objected to Manners-Sutton's Tory partisanship. James Abercromby was proposed by William Denison and seconded by William Ord. Both candidates addressed the House.

zh.s: 1835年2月19日，英国下议院举行议长选举。自1817年担任议长的查尔斯·曼纳斯-萨顿爵士争取第八个任期。弗朗西斯·埃格顿勋爵提名他，查尔斯·伯勒尔爵士附议。辉格党反对曼纳斯-萨顿偏袒托利党的立场。威廉·丹尼森提名詹姆斯·阿伯克龙比，威廉·奥德附议。两名候选人都向下议院发表了讲话。

en.t: William IV issues Letters Patent establishing South Australia
en.s: On 19 February 1836, William IV issued Letters Patent at Westminster in the United Kingdom establishing the Province of South Australia and defining its boundaries. The document included a clause protecting Aboriginal inhabitants’ existing rights to occupy or enjoy their land.

zh.t: 威廉四世颁发设立南澳大利亚省的特许状
zh.s: 1836年2月19日，英国国王威廉四世在威斯敏斯特颁发特许状，设立南澳大利亚省并划定边界。文件还规定，不得影响当地原住民及其后代对已占有或使用土地的权利。

en.s: The Battle of Krzywosadz was one of battles of the January Uprising. It took place in the village of Krzywosadz, Congress Poland, on February 19, 1863, when poorly armed party of 500 Polish insurgents, under Ludwik Mieroslawski, clashed with a 1,000 strong unit of the Imperial Russian Army. In the night of February 17/18, 1863, an Imperial Russian Army unit, stationed in Wloclawek was alarmed by the news that Polish insurgents concentrated near the village of Niszczewy in the region of Kujawy. The Russians, commanded by Colonel Yury Ivanovich Szylder, immediately marched to Sluzew, where they joined Russian border guards.

zh.s: 克日沃松兹战役是一月起义中的一场战斗。1863年2月19日，路德维克·米耶罗斯瓦夫斯基率领约500名装备简陋的波兰起义者，在波兰会议王国的克日沃松兹村与约1000名俄国帝国陆军士兵交战。2月17日至18日夜间，驻扎在弗沃茨瓦韦克的俄军获悉，波兰起义者正在库亚维地区的尼什切维村附近集结。尤里·伊万诺维奇·希尔德上校随即率军赶往斯武热夫，与当地俄国边防部队会合。

en.s: The Passage of Humaitá (Portuguese: Passagem de Humaitá) was an operation of riverine warfare during the Paraguayan War − the most lethal in South American history − in which a force of six Imperial Brazilian Navy armoured vessels was ordered to dash past under the guns of the Paraguayan fortress of Humaitá. Some competent neutral observers had considered that the feat was very nearly impossible. The purpose of the exercise was to stop the Paraguayans resupplying the fortress by river, and to provide the Empire of Brazil and its Allies with a much-needed propaganda victory. The attempt took place on 19 February 1868 and was successful – the attackers had hit upon the fortress' weakness.

zh.s: 突破乌迈塔要塞（葡萄牙语：Passagem de Humaitá）是巴拉圭战争期间的一次河战行动；这场战争是南美洲历史上伤亡最惨重的战争。巴西帝国海军出动6艘装甲舰，奉命冒着巴拉圭乌迈塔要塞的炮火高速驶过。几位有能力的中立观察员认为，这几乎是不可能完成的任务。行动意在阻止巴拉圭人通过河道向要塞运送补给，并为巴西帝国及其盟友赢得急需的宣传胜利。1868年2月19日，行动成功，进攻方找到了要塞的弱点。

en.s: The Wairau by-election 1872 was a by-election held in the Wairau electorate during the 5th New Zealand Parliament, on 19 February 1872. The by-election was caused by the resignation of incumbent MP William Henry Eyes and was won by Arthur Seymour, who defeated Joseph Ward. Both candidates were prominent Marlborough politicians, and for both of them, this was their first attempt at election to the General Assembly.

en.s: On February 19–20, 1884, a large tornado outbreak occurred over the Southeastern United States, known as the Enigma tornado outbreak due to the uncertain number of total tornadoes and fatalities. Nonetheless, an inspection of newspaper reports and governmental studies published in the aftermath reveals successive, long-tracked tornado families striking Alabama, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee and Virginia, with an estimation of at least 51—and possibly 60 or more—tornadoes striking that Tuesday into Wednesday.

zh.s: 1884年2月19日至20日，美国东南部发生大规模龙卷风群，因龙卷风和死亡人数不确定而得名“谜团”。不过，事后的报纸报道和政府研究显示，多场持续时间长、行进路线长的龙卷风接连袭击阿拉巴马、佐治亚、伊利诺伊、印第安纳、肯塔基、密西西比、北卡罗来纳、南卡罗来纳、田纳西和弗吉尼亚州。估计当时至少有51场龙卷风，可能达到60场甚至更多；它们从那个星期二持续到星期三。

en.s: The Ten Tragic Days (Spanish: La Decena Trágica) is the name given to the multi-day coup d'état during the Mexican Revolution in Mexico City. It was staged by opponents of Francisco I. Madero, the democratically elected president of Mexico, between 9–19 February 1913. The coup instigated a second phase of the Mexican Revolution, after dictator Porfirio Díaz had been ousted and replaced in elections by Francisco I.

en.s: The Gallipoli campaign, the Dardanelles campaign, the Defence of Gallipoli or the Battle of Gallipoli (Turkish: Gelibolu Muharebesi, Çanakkale Muharebeleri or Çanakkale Savaşı) was a military campaign in the First World War on the Gallipoli Peninsula (now Gelibolu) from 19 February 1915 to 9 January 1916. The Allied powers (Britain, France and the Russian Empire) unsuccessfully attempted to make the Ottoman Empire, one of the Central Powers, capitulate by taking control of the Turkish straits.

zh.s: 加里波利战役又称达达尼尔战役、加里波利保卫战，是第一次世界大战期间于1915年2月19日至1916年1月9日在加里波利半岛（今盖利博卢）进行的军事行动。英国、法国和俄罗斯帝国等协约国试图控制土耳其海峡，迫使同盟国成员奥斯曼帝国投降，但未能成功。

en.t: Allied warships bombard the Dardanelles outer defenses
en.s: On 19 February 1915, British and French warships began their attack on the outer defenses of the Dardanelles, in present-day Turkey. Ottoman batteries opened fire as ships probed the straits; HMS Cornwallis then engaged the forts.

zh.t: 协约国军舰炮击达达尼尔海峡外围防御工事
zh.s: 1915年2月19日，英国和法国军舰开始攻击达达尼尔海峡的外围防御工事，地点位于今土耳其。军舰试探海峡时，奥斯曼岸炮开火，随后英国“康沃利斯”号战列舰向堡垒射击。

en.s: The Louisiana gubernatorial election of 1924 was held in two rounds on January 15 and February 19, 1924. Like most Southern states between Reconstruction and the civil rights era, Louisiana's Republican Party was virtually nonexistent in terms of electoral support. This meant that the two Democratic Party primaries held on these dates were the real contest over who would be governor. The 1924 election saw Henry L. Fuqua defeat Hewitt Bouanchaud to become Governor of Louisiana, and saw the beginning of the political rise of Huey P. Long, who came in a surprisingly strong third.

zh.s: 1924年路易斯安那州州长选举的两轮投票分别于1月15日和2月19日举行。从重建时期到民权运动时代，路易斯安那与多数美国南方州一样，共和党在选举中几乎没有支持基础，因此这两轮民主党初选实际上决定了州长人选。亨利·L.富夸击败休伊特·布安肖德，当选州长。休伊·P.朗则以出人意料的强劲表现获得第三名，从此开始在政坛崛起。

en.s: The Battle of Amba Aradam (also known as the Battle of Enderta) was fought on the northern front of what was known as the Second Italo-Abyssinian War. This battle consisted of attacks and counter-attacks by Italian forces under Marshal of Italy Pietro Badoglio and Ethiopian forces under Ras Mulugeta Yeggazu. This battle was primarily fought in the area around Amba Aradam which included most of Enderta Province.

en.s: The Battle of Gogetti was the final battle between Ethiopia and the Italy preluding the Second World War. This battle was fought against the surviving troops of the armies of Sidamo and Bale. The Ethiopian armies were encircled and destroyed by the Italian forces near Lake Shala. Ethiopian leaders Beiene Merid and Dejazmach Gabre Mariam were killed in battle.

zh.s: 戈盖蒂之战是第二次世界大战前埃塞俄比亚与意大利之间的最后一场战斗。交战的埃塞俄比亚部队是西达莫和巴莱两支军队的残部。意大利军队在沙拉湖附近包围并击溃埃塞俄比亚军队，埃塞俄比亚将领贝耶内·梅里德和德贾兹马奇·加布雷·马里亚姆阵亡。

zh.s: 1942年2月19日，日军飞机空袭澳大利亚北部的达尔文，轰炸港口及市区，造成严重破坏和人员伤亡。

en.s: The Battle of Timor occurred in Portuguese Timor and Dutch Timor during the Second World War. Japanese forces invaded the island on 19 February 1942 and were resisted by a small, under-equipped force of Allied military personnel—known as Sparrow Force—predominantly from Australia, the United Kingdom, and the Dutch East Indies.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，帝汶岛葡属和荷属地区发生战斗。1942年2月19日，日军入侵该岛，遭到一支规模较小、装备不足的盟军部队抵抗。这支部队称为“麻雀部队”，主要来自澳大利亚、英国和荷属东印度群岛。

en.s: On February 19, 1942, US President Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 9066. It authorized military exclusion areas and was used to force Japanese Americans from their homes and incarcerate them.

zh.s: 1942年2月19日，美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福签署第9066号行政命令，授权设立军事禁区。这项命令随后被用于强迫日裔美国人离开家园，并将他们大规模关押。

en.s: The Battle of Kasserine Pass was a series of engagements which took place from 19–24 February 1943 around Kasserine Pass, a 2-mile-wide (3.2 km) gap in the Grand Dorsal chain of the Atlas Mountains in west central Tunisia. It was a part of the Tunisian campaign of World War II.

en.s: The Conference of Youth and Students of Southeast Asia Fighting for Freedom and Independence, also referred to as the Southeast Asian Youth Conference, was an international youth and students event held in Calcutta, India on February 19–23, 1948. en.s: The Northern Ireland general election, 1949 was held on 19 February 1949. The election became known as the Chapel-gate election because collections were held at churches in the Republic of Ireland to support the Nationalist Party campaign. The election was held just after the Republic of Ireland's declaration of a republic. The Unionists were able to use their majority in the Parliament of Northern Ireland to schedule the election at a time when many Protestants felt uneasy about development south of the border and as a result might be more likely to vote Unionist than for Labour candidates.

zh.s: 1949年北爱尔兰大选于2月19日举行。这次选举被称为“教堂门口选举”，因为爱尔兰共和国的教堂曾募款支持民族党的竞选。选举举行前不久，爱尔兰刚宣布成立共和国。统一派利用其在北爱尔兰议会的多数地位，将选举安排在许多新教徒对边境以南局势感到不安的时候。这种情绪可能使他们更愿意支持统一派，而不是工党候选人。

en.s: The Louisiana gubernatorial election of 1952 was held in two rounds on January 15 and February 19, 1952. Like most Southern states between Reconstruction and the civil rights era, Louisiana's Republican Party was virtually nonexistent in terms of electoral support. This meant that the two Democratic Party primary elections held on these dates were the real contest over who would be governor of Louisiana. The 1952 election saw the defeat of Long candidate Carlos Spaht, and the election of Robert F. Kennon as governor. In the low-turnout general election held on April 22, 1952, Kennon defeated Harrison Bagwell, a Baton Rouge lawyer and only the second Louisiana Republican gubernatorial nominee since Reconstruction.

zh.s: 1952年路易斯安那州州长选举的两轮投票分别于1月15日和2月19日举行。从重建时期到民权运动时代，路易斯安那与多数美国南方州一样，共和党在选举中几乎没有支持基础，因此这两轮民主党初选实际上决定了州长人选。朗派候选人卡洛斯·斯帕特落败，罗伯特·F.肯农胜出。在4月22日举行、投票率较低的正式选举中，肯农击败了巴吞鲁日律师哈里森·巴格韦尔。巴格韦尔是重建时期以来，路易斯安那州共和党推出的第二位州长候选人。

en.s: The 1955 Tasmanian state election was held on 19 February 1955 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 30 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — six members were elected from each of five electorates. The incumbent Labor government, led by Robert Cosgrove, had been in office continuously since 1934, although had not held a majority since 1946.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 19 February 1956. The result was a victory for Constantine Karamanlis and his National Radical Union party by securing the electoral vote despite trailing in the popular vote. It was the first general election in Greece in which women had the right to vote, although women had first voted in a by-election in Thessaloniki Prefecture in 1953 in which the first female MP was elected. Although the Liberal Democratic Union, a coalition of centrist parties, received a slim plurality of votes, the conservative governing party, the National Radical Union, won the most seats due to a complex and controversial electoral system enacted by Karamanlis.

zh.s: 希腊于1956年2月19日举行议会选举。康斯坦丁·卡拉曼利斯领导的全国激进联盟虽然普选票落后，仍在议席分配中胜出。这是希腊女性首次有权参加全国大选投票；此前，女性已在1953年塞萨洛尼基州的一次补选中投票，那次选举还产生了希腊首位女议员。中间派政党组成的自由民主联盟获得的选票略多，但卡拉曼利斯制定的选举制度复杂且争议很大，使执政的保守派全国激进联盟赢得最多议席。

en.s: The 1962 election to the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly in India resulted in the re-election of Chandra Bhanu Gupta of the Indian National Congress as Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh. His election manager Nirmal Chandra Chaturvedi had played a major role in getting him elected. Congress retained a commanding majority despite losing some seats to the Bharatiya Jana Sangh.

zh.s: 印度北方邦于1962年举行立法议会选举，印度国民大会党的钱德拉·巴努·古普塔再次当选首席部长。他的竞选负责人尼尔马尔·钱德拉·查图尔维迪在助选中发挥了重要作用。国大党虽丢失部分席位给印度人民同盟，仍保有明显多数。

en.s: The 1962 Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly election was held in 1962. It was the third after formation of states. The INC won 177 seats out of 300 seats. CPI won 51 seats and Independents also won 51 seats. The number of polling stations was 21,587 and the number of electors per polling station was 881.

zh.s: 安得拉邦于1962年举行立法议会选举，这是邦成立后的第三次选举。印度国民大会党赢得300席中的177席；印度共产党和无党派候选人各赢得51席。全邦设有21,587个投票站，平均每个投票站对应881名选民。

en.t: 1963 Mississippi House of Representatives special election in Lauderdale County
en.s: Lauderdale County in Mississippi held a special election on February 5, 1963, and February 19, 1963, to elect a new member of the Mississippi House of Representatives. The election filled the 11-month remainder of incumbent Democratic representative Natie Caraway's term, who resigned on January 1, 1963, after relocating to Jackson. Lewis McAllister won the seat during the February 19 runoff, flipping the seat to the Republicans.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1963年密西西比州劳德代尔县州众议员特别选举
zh.s: 1963年2月5日和19日，密西西比州劳德代尔县举行特别选举，选出新的州众议员，以接替民主党议员内蒂·卡拉韦剩余11个月的任期。卡拉韦于1月1日搬到杰克逊后辞职。刘易斯·麦卡利斯特在2月19日的第二轮投票中获胜，使该席位转由共和党掌握。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的复选日期。

en.s: On February 19, 1965, some units of the Army of the Republic of Vietnam commanded by General Lâm Văn Phát and Colonel Phạm Ngọc Thảo launched a coup against General Nguyễn Khánh, the head of South Vietnam's ruling military junta. Their aim was to install General Trần Thiện Khiêm, a Khánh rival who had been sent to Washington D.C. as Ambassador to the United States to prevent him from seizing power.

zh.s: 1965年2月19日，林文发将军和范玉草上校指挥部分越南共和国陆军部队发动政变，反对南越执政军政府首脑阮庆将军。他们打算拥立阮庆的政敌陈善谦将军。此前，为防止陈善谦夺权，他被派往华盛顿担任驻美国大使。

en.t: Haryana holds its first general assembly election as a separate state
en.s: On 19 February 1967, Haryana, India, held its first general legislative assembly election after becoming a separate state in1966. The Indian National Congress won an absolute majority.
en.n: The date follows Indian parliamentary historical records, corroborated by a Supreme Court election case, rather than the retained article’s February21 infobox.

zh.t: 哈里亚纳邦建邦后首次举行议会普选
zh.s: 1967年2月19日，印度哈里亚纳邦举行建邦后的首次议会普选。该邦于1966年成立，印度国民大会党在这次选举中赢得绝对多数议席。
zh.n: 日期采用印度议会历史资料，并有最高法院选举案件佐证，纠正原文资料框所写的2月21日。

en.s: The 1968 South African presidential election resulted in the unanimous election of Jacobus Johannes Fouché of the National Party by the South African Parliament. Fouché was elected to the ceremonial post of State President of South Africa on February 19, 1968, and was sworn in on April 10, 1968. He was the only South African State President to serve a full seven-year term, which ended on 9 April 1975.

zh.s: 1968年南非总统选举中，国民党的雅各布斯·约翰内斯·富歇在南非议会获得一致支持。他于2月19日当选承担礼仪职责的国家总统，并于4月10日宣誓就职。他是唯一做满七年任期的南非国家总统，任期于1975年4月9日结束。

en.s: The Battle of Hat Dich (3 December 1968 − 19 February 1969) was a series of military actions fought between an allied contingent, including the 1st Australian Task Force (1 ATF) and the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) and Viet Cong (VC) during the Vietnam War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 哈特迪克战役是1968年12月3日至1969年2月19日之间一系列军事行动的总称。越南战争期间，交战双方是包括澳大利亚第一特遣部队（1 ATF）在内的盟军，以及越南人民军（PAVN）和越共（VC）。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Asama-Sansō incident (あさま山荘事件, Asama sansō jiken) was a hostage crisis and police standoff at a mountain lodge near Karuizawa in Nagano Prefecture, Japan, which lasted from February 19 to February 28, 1972. The police rescue operation on the final day of the standoff was the first marathon live television broadcast in Japan, lasting 10 hours and 40 minutes.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 浅间山庄事件（日语：あさま山荘事件，罗马字：Asama sansō jiken）是1972年2月19日至28日在日本长野县轻井泽附近一座山庄发生的人质危机和警方对峙。对峙最后一天，警方展开救援行动，这是日本首次长达10小时40分钟的马拉松式电视直播。

en.s: Elections were held in the state of Western Australia on 19 February 1977 to elect all 55 members to the Legislative Assembly and 17 members to the 32-seat Legislative Council. The Liberal-National Country coalition government, led by Premier Sir Charles Court, won a second term in office against the Labor Party, led by Opposition Leader Colin Jamieson.

zh.s: 西澳大利亚州于1977年2月19日举行选举，改选立法议会全部55席，以及32席立法委员会中的17席。由州长查尔斯·考特爵士领导的自由党—国民乡村党联合政府击败反对党领袖科林·贾米森领导的工党，赢得第二个任期。

en.t: Egyptian raid on Larnaca International Airport
en.s: On 19 February 1978, Egyptian special forces raided Larnaca International Airport near Larnaca, Cyprus, in an attempt to intervene in a hijacking. Earlier, two assassins had killed prominent Egyptian newspaper editor Youssef Sebai and then rounded up as hostages several Arabs who were attending a convention in Nicosia. As Cypriot forces were trying to negotiate with the hostage-takers at the airport, Egyptian troops launched their own assault without authorization from the Cypriots. The unauthorized raid led to the Egyptians and the Cypriots exchanging gunfire, killing or injuring more than 20 of the Egyptian commandos.

zh.t: 埃及突袭拉纳卡国际机场
zh.s: 1978年2月19日，埃及特种部队突袭塞浦路斯拉纳卡附近的拉纳卡国际机场，试图介入一场劫机事件。此前，两名刺客杀害了埃及知名报刊编辑优素福·塞巴伊，并劫持了数名在尼科西亚参加会议的阿拉伯人。当塞浦路斯部队正在机场与劫持者谈判时，埃及军队未经塞方许可自行发动攻击。双方随即交火，造成20多名埃及突击队员死伤。

en.s: The Battle of Cao Ba Lanh (also known as the Battle of Hill 1050) was part of the Battle of Móng Cái, fought during the Sino-Vietnamese War between February and March 1979 near the city of Móng Cái and other districts of Quảng Ninh Province that bordered the People's Republic of China.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 高巴兰山之战又称1050高地之战，是1979年中越战争期间芒街战役的一部分，发生于2月至3月间。战斗地点在芒街附近，以及越南广宁省其他与中华人民共和国接壤的地区。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Elections were held in the state of Western Australia on 19 February 1983 to elect all 57 members to the Legislative Assembly and 18 members to the 34-seat Legislative Council. The three-term Liberal-National Country coalition government, led by Premier Ray O'Connor since 25 January 1982 (after the retirement of Sir Charles Court) was defeated by the Labor Party, led by Opposition Leader Brian Burke since 10 September 1981.

zh.s: 西澳大利亚州于1983年2月19日举行选举，改选立法议会全部57席，以及34席立法委员会中的18席。自由党—国民乡村党联合政府已连续执政三个任期，由州长雷·奥康纳自1982年1月25日起领导；此前查尔斯·考特爵士退休。该联合政府在反对党领袖布赖恩·伯克领导的工党挑战下落败。伯克自1981年9月10日起担任工党领袖。

en.s: Iberia Flight 610 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Madrid to Bilbao, Basque Country, Spain. On 19 February 1985, a Boeing 727-200 operating the flight crashed into a ravine after one of its wings sliced a television antenna on the summit of Mount Oiz in Biscay during an approach to Bilbao Airport. All 141 passengers and 7 crew on board died.

zh.t: 伊比利亚航空610号班机空难
zh.s: 伊比利亚航空610号班机是从马德里飞往西班牙巴斯克地区毕尔巴鄂的国内定期客运航班。1985年2月19日，执飞的一架波音727-200在进近毕尔巴鄂机场时，一侧机翼撞上比斯开省奥伊斯山山顶的电视天线，随后坠入山谷。机上141名乘客和7名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: China Airlines Flight 006 was a daily non-stop international passenger flight from Taipei to Los Angeles International Airport. On February 19, 1985, the Boeing 747SP operating the flight was involved in an aircraft upset accident, following the failure of the No. 4 engine, while cruising at 41,000 ft (12,000 m).

zh.s: 中华航空006号班机是从台北直飞洛杉矶国际机场的每日定期国际客运航班。1985年2月19日，执行该航班的波音747SP客机在41,000英尺（12,000米）巡航时，因4号发动机故障而发生飞机失控事故。

en.s: Akkaraipattu massacre happened on 19 February 1986 when approximately 80 Tamil farm workers were killed by the Sri Lankan Army personnel with the assistance of Muslim Home Guards and their bodies burned in the Eastern Province of Sri Lanka. The incident came to light a few days later when community leaders visited the remote location in the village of Udumbankulam near the town of Akkaraipattu, where the farm workers were shot.

zh.s: 1986年2月19日，斯里兰卡东部省阿卡赖帕图附近发生屠杀，斯里兰卡军方在穆斯林民兵协助下杀害约80名泰米尔农场工人，并焚烧遗体。数日后，社区领袖前往阿卡赖帕图附近乌杜班库拉姆村的偏远地区，发现工人被枪杀的地点，事件才为外界所知。

en.s: The Thai–Laotian Border War (December 1987 – February 1988) was a short confrontation between Thai and Laotian forces. It was caused by a dispute involving the map made by French surveyors in 1907 to mark the borders between Siam and French Indochina in the southern Luang Prabang Range mountain area. Ownership of the village of Ban Romklao on the border of Phitsanulok Province and three small border villages on the edge of Uttaradit Province was left unclear. (This is the same map underlying the Cambodian–Thai border dispute. The agreed factor in determining ownership was the natural watershed, but the French map makers at times ignored this.)

zh.s: 泰老边境战争是泰国与老挝军队在1987年12月至1988年2月间发生的一场短暂冲突。争端源于法国测绘人员1907年绘制的一幅地图，该图用于划定暹罗与法属印度支那在琅勃拉邦山脉南部的边界。位于彭世洛府边境的班隆告村，以及程逸府边缘的三个边境小村，归属一直不明确。柬泰边境争端所依据的也是这幅地图。双方原先同意以天然分水岭划界，但法国制图人员有时没有遵循这一原则。

en.s: AVAir Flight 3378 was a scheduled flight from Raleigh–Durham International Airport to Richmond International Airport operated by Air Virginia that crashed after takeoff from Raleigh-Durham International Airport late on the night of February 19, 1988. All 12 people on board were killed in the accident.

zh.s: AVAir航空3378号班机是由弗吉尼亚航空运营、从罗利—达勒姆国际机场飞往里士满国际机场的定期航班。1988年2月19日深夜，飞机从罗利—达勒姆起飞后坠毁，机上12人全部遇难。

en.s: Flying Tiger Line Flight 066 was a scheduled international cargo flight from Changi Airport to Kai Tak Airport via a stopover at Kuala Lumpur International Airport. On 19 February 1989, the FedEx-owned Boeing 747-249F-SCD crashed while on its final approach. The aircraft impacted a hillside 437 ft (133 m) above sea level and 12 km (7.5 mi; 6.5 nmi) from Kuala Lumpur, resulting in all four occupants being killed.

zh.s: 飞虎航空066号班机是从樟宜机场出发、经停吉隆坡国际机场飞往启德机场的定期国际货运航班。1989年2月19日，联邦快递旗下执飞该航班的一架波音747-249F-SCD，在最后进近阶段坠毁。飞机撞上距吉隆坡12公里、海拔437英尺的一处山坡；距离约合7.5英里或6.5海里，海拔约合133米。机上四人全部遇难。

en.s: The Battle of Shire was fought from February 8 to 19 February 1989, in and around the town of Shire, as part of the Ethiopian Civil War, and resulted in the destruction of the Ethiopian 604th Army Corps.

en.s: The 1993 Meghalaya Legislative Assembly election was held on 19 February 1993. Following the election a coalition government called the Meghalaya United Front was formed between the Indian National Congress and a split from the Hill State People's Democratic Party, the All Party Hill Leaders Conference (Armison Marak Group) and several independents. S. C. Marak was elected as Chief Minister.

zh.s: 1993年梅加拉亚邦议会选举于2月19日举行。选举后，印度国民大会党、从山地邦人民民主党分裂出来的一派、山地领袖全民会议的阿米森·马拉克派，以及数名独立议员，组成名为“梅加拉亚联合阵线”的联合政府。S.C.马拉克当选首席部长。

en.t: 1993 President of the Hong Kong Legislative Council election
en.s: An election for the president of the Legislative Council of Hong Kong took place on 19 February 1993 for members to among themselves elect the first President after abolishing the practice for the governor to preside. Deputy President John Joseph Swaine was unopposed and became the first elected president.

zh.s: 香港立法局于1993年2月19日举行主席选举，由议员互选主席；此前已废除由总督主持立法局的做法。副主席约翰·约瑟夫·斯韦恩在没有对手的情况下当选，成为首位民选主席。

en.s: The 1994 Sabah state election was held between Friday, 18 February and Saturday, 19 February 1994. The election was one of the most controversial election in Sabah's political history. The election was won by the incumbent ruling party (although the opposition at federal level) Parti Bersatu Sabah (PBS), winning 25 state electorates against 23 won by the federal government's ruling Barisan Nasional coalition. However, due to defections by elected PBS assemblymen by way of establishments of new parties aligned to BN shortly after the election, PBS was forced out of power resulting in BN forming government in Sabah.

zh.s: 1994年沙巴州选举于2月18日星期五至19日星期六举行，是沙巴政治史上争议最大的一次选举之一。执政的沙巴团结党赢得25个州议席，联邦执政联盟国民阵线赢得23席；沙巴团结党当时在联邦层面属于反对党。不过，选举后不久，一些当选的团结党议员退党，另组政党并靠向国民阵线。沙巴团结党因此被迫下台，由国民阵线在沙巴组建政府。

en.s: The 1995 Hessian state election was held on 19 February 1995 to elect the members of the 14th Landtag of Hesse. The outgoing government was a coalition of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and The Greens led by Minister-President Hans Eichel. The opposition Christian Democratic Union (CDU) returned as the largest party despite small losses.

zh.s: 1995年2月19日，德国黑森州举行选举，选出第14届州议会议员。上届政府由州长汉斯·艾歇尔领导，是社会民主党与绿党的联合政府。反对党基督教民主联盟虽然支持有所下降，仍再次成为第一大党。

en.s: SuperBrawl V was the fifth SuperBrawl professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). The event took place on February 19, 1995 from the Baltimore Arena in Baltimore, Maryland. In the main event, Hulk Hogan successfully defended the World Heavyweight Championship against Big Van Vader as Vader was disqualified due to Ric Flair's interference in the match.

zh.s: “超级争霸赛V”是世界冠军摔角联盟（WCW）举办的第五届“超级争霸赛”职业摔角按次付费赛事，于1995年2月19日在马里兰州巴尔的摩竞技场举行。主赛中，里克·弗莱尔干扰比赛，导致Big Van Vader被取消资格，浩克·霍根因此成功卫冕世界重量级冠军。

en.t: Manipur holds its second polling day in the 1995 assembly election
en.s: On 19 February 1995, Manipur, India, held the second polling day of its legislative assembly election. Voting took place on February16 and19; the Indian National Congress won the largest number of seats.
en.n: This entry records the second of the two explicitly listed polling dates, not the entire election on one day.

zh.t: 曼尼普尔邦议会选举举行第二天投票
zh.s: 1995年2月19日，印度曼尼普尔邦议会选举举行第二天投票。这次选举的投票日期为2月16日和19日，印度国民大会党赢得最多议席。

en.s: The Ein 'Arik checkpoint attack occurred 19 February 2002. One Israeli officer and 5 soldiers were killed in an attack on an IDF checkpoint near the Palestinian village of Ein 'Arik, west of Ramallah in the Israeli-occupied West Bank.

zh.t: 艾因·阿里克检查站袭击事件
zh.s: 2002年2月19日，巴勒斯坦村庄艾因·阿里克附近的以色列国防军检查站遭到袭击，1名以色列军官和5名士兵死亡。检查站位于拉姆安拉以西的以色列占领下的约旦河西岸。

en.s: On 19 February 2003, an Ilyushin Il-76 crashed in mountainous terrain near Kerman in Iran. The Aerospace Force of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps aircraft, registration 15-2280, was flying from Zahedan to Kerman when it crashed 35 kilometres (22 mi; 19 nmi) southeast of Kerman. The aircraft was carrying members of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard, a special force that is independent from the Iranian Army, on an unknown mission.

zh.t: 2003年伊朗伊尔-76运输机坠毁事故
zh.s: 2003年2月19日，一架伊留申伊尔-76运输机在伊朗克尔曼附近的山区坠毁。这架隶属伊斯兰革命卫队航空航天部队、注册号为15-2280的飞机，当时正从扎黑丹飞往克尔曼，坠毁地点位于克尔曼东南35公里，约22英里或19海里。机上搭载伊斯兰革命卫队成员，所执行的任务不明。革命卫队是一支独立于伊朗陆军的特殊武装力量。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Armenia on 19 February and 5 March 2003. No candidate received a majority in the first round of the election with the incumbent President Robert Kocharyan winning slightly under 50% of the vote. Therefore, a second round was held and Kocharyan defeated Stepan Demirchyan with official results showed him winning just over 67% of the vote.

zh.s: 亚美尼亚于2003年2月19日和3月5日举行总统选举。首轮无人获得过半选票，在任总统罗伯特·科恰良的得票略低于50%。因此举行第二轮投票，科恰良击败斯捷潘·杰米尔强，官方结果显示其得票略高于67%。

en.s: No Way Out (2006) was the eighth annual No Way Out professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It was presented by Subway. It took place on February 19, 2006, at 1st Mariner Arena in Baltimore, Maryland and was a SmackDown! brand-exclusive event. The official theme song was "Deadly Game" by Theory of a Deadman. The main event saw Kurt Angle defend his World Heavyweight Championship against The Undertaker. Angle won the match after reversing a Triangle Choke into a jackknife cover. One of the predominant matches on the card was Randy Orton versus Rey Mysterio for Mysterio's world championship match at WrestleMania 22.

en.s: The Pasta de Conchos mine disaster occurred at approximately 2:30 a.m. CST on February 19, 2006, after a methane explosion within a coal mine near Nueva Rosita, San Juan de Sabinas municipality, in the Mexican state of Coahuila. The mines were run by Grupo México, the largest mining company in the country. It was estimated that 65 miners, who were working the 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. shift that morning, were trapped underground by the explosion. Only 2 of the 65 bodies have been recovered. There have been conflicting reports regarding the depth at which the miners were trapped.

zh.s: 2006年2月19日中部标准时间凌晨约2时30分，墨西哥科阿韦拉州圣胡安德萨比纳斯市、新罗西塔附近的一座煤矿发生甲烷爆炸，引发帕斯塔德孔乔斯矿难。该矿由墨西哥最大的矿业公司墨西哥集团经营。据估计，爆炸使65名矿工被困井下，他们当时正在上前一晚10点至早晨6点的班。原文记载，65名遇难者中只有两人的遗体被寻获。关于矿工被困的地下深度，不同报道说法不一。

en.t: Putin claims Russian troops crossed into Ukraine’s Sumy region
en.s: On 19 February 2025, Vladimir Putin said that Russian troops had crossed into Ukraine’s Sumy region. Ukrainian officials denied the claim. The statement was made during a visit to a drone factory in Saint Petersburg, Russia.
en.n: This is the date of a public statement, not independent confirmation of the claimed border crossing or the offensive’s starting date.

zh.t: 普京称俄军已越境进入乌克兰苏梅地区
zh.s: 2025年2月19日，普京在俄罗斯圣彼得堡参观一家无人机工厂时，称俄军已越境进入乌克兰苏梅地区。乌克兰官员否认了这一说法。
zh.n: 此条记录公开表态的日期，并不代表已独立证实所称的越境行动，也不据此认定攻势的开始日期。
